authority: visual and interaction projection only; not a schedule, recognition mechanism, readiness model, authority source, causal cosmology, or replacement for TempusContext
purpose: Define a bounded live rendering in which a selected Tempus phase may move independently of a voluntary Vitae grade-cycle coordinate, making pause, rest, phase wrap, and relative motion perceptible without creating timing obligations or advancement effects.

default_tempus_cycle.status: presentation-safe factual cycle derived from device-local clock
default_tempus_cycle.meaning: where the local civil day currently is
default_tempus_cycle.reason_for_default: It can be derived from capturedAt and local timezone without inventing astronomical or symbolic data that the prototype does not actually compute.

vitae_cycle.state_set: C360 discrete cyclic index for presentation within one grade; actual advancement and recognition remain outside this projection
vitae_cycle.posture: navigation coordinate only; phase does not imply readiness or completion

state_space_refinement.reason: Tempus may be rendered as continuously changing phase, while the registered Vitae state is an explicit integer section coordinate. Normalizing the Vitae index onto a circle is useful for rendering but does not make advancement continuous.
state_space_refinement.whole_core_extension: S1_Tempus x {grade 1..10} x C360_Vitae, with optional ten-turn spiral presentation

hybrid_dynamics.pause: Tempus changes while Vitae index remains fixed
hybrid_dynamics.vitae_event: Vitae index may change at a captured moment without retroactively changing prior Tempus samples

state_space_refinement.candidate_law: Continuous Geometry Must Not Imply Continuous Advancement.

product_phase_space.topological_note: The phase square with opposite edges identified is the same continuous presentation envelope and must remain available as a geometry-light equivalent.
product_phase_space.state_machine_note: The renderer may draw smooth geometry between indexed Vitae bands for legibility, but persisted Vitae state must snap to registered section coordinates rather than interpolate.

relative_phase.vitae_phase_basis: start coordinate of the current indexed Vitae section

TempusWrap.meaning: cycle recurrence in the selected Tempus projection

VitaeMove.trigger: explicit participant control or recorded practice/navigation event only

trajectory_grammar.phase_square: With Tempus on x and Vitae on y, rest produces horizontal motion/wrap at constant Vitae; explicit Vitae events produce discrete changes in the y coordinate at a moment in Tempus.
trajectory_grammar.torus: Rest produces a loop around the Tempus direction at a fixed Vitae band; voluntary Vitae events move the point to another indexed band.
trajectory_grammar.interpretation: Participant history is therefore a hybrid event trajectory, not a forced diagonal progress line.

pause_and_rest_test.operation: allow Tempus phase to advance for one or more complete selected cycles
pause_and_rest_test.required_result: Vitae remains at the same coordinate while the product-space point traces a closed Tempus-direction loop
pause_and_rest_test.forbidden_result: debt, lateness, missed lesson, automatic catch-up, loss of standing, recognition change

operator_separation.rule: Tempus is displayed beside or around the current operator event. It may timestamp the event but does not change the operator's pitch trajectory, pan trajectory, timbre family, or semantic identity.
operator_separation.candidate_law: Context May Move Around the Operator; It May Not Rewrite the Operator.

candidate_laws: Relative Phase Is Descriptive, Not Evaluative.
Temporal Wrap Is Not Curriculum Return.
Tempus Does Not Modulate the Operator.
Context May Move Around the Operator; It May Not Rewrite the Operator.
Continuous Geometry Must Not Imply Continuous Advancement.
The Torus Is an Envelope, Not the State Machine.
next_gate_if_passed: Add the stable ARCnet stellar frame as a transported visual frame around captured Tempus-Vitae samples while proving that system identities, authority boundaries, and Edge Contract requirements remain unchanged.
